title: DynmapSkinFix
description: this plugin fix dynmap skin for minecraft 1.2.5
body:
# DynmapSkinFix ## Overview DynmapSkinFix is a Minecraft plugin designed to download and store player skins for use with Dynmap. It automatically updates the skins of all online players at a specified interval. ## Features - Automatically downloads player skins from Minotar.net. - Stores skins in the specified directory for Dynmap. - Provides a command to manually update skins for all online players. ## Installation 1. Place the `DynmapSkinFix` plugin JAR file into the `plugins` directory of your Minecraft server. 2. Ensure that the Dynmap plugin is installed and configured properly. 3. Restart the server to enable the plugin. ## Configuration The plugin does not require any additional configuration. It will create a directory for storing player skins at the following path: ## Commands - `/updateskins`: Manually triggers an update of skins for all online players. ## Permissions - `dynmapskinfix.update`: Allows the use of the `/updateskins` command. Default is set to operator (op). ---
